verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a configurable card-products resource for physical and virtual cards, Just-in-Time funding that lets your own system approve funding decisions, and business account holders with parent/child card-holding users. Together these suggest more than a single prepaid rail and some commercial or workforce use. However, no item explicitly names debit, prepaid, or any credit program. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of debit and prepaid program types, any evidence of commercial or consumer credit programs (credit lines, billing, statements), and independent corroboration of multi-program support.
